scope: UnifiedDB + Database Pulse + Evidence Coalition + EAP/ClayGraph + projection maintenance integration

architecture_hypothesis.statement: The winning Frank workload architecture is not a monolithic replacement database. It is an authoritative event/state plane plus a disposable model-input compiler that assembles the smallest sufficient provenance-bound evidence/possibility coalition and selectively deepens explicit gaps.

layers.name: AUTHORITATIVE_STATE_EVENT_PLANE
layers.law: semantic/logical state, epochs, provenance, transactions, replay and raw event identity remain authoritative here; conventional physical indexes are allowed when Pareto-best

layers.name: NONSEMANTIC_PULSE_EXECUTION_PLANE
layers.law: consume complete authoritative StateLedger events and persist Pulse cursor/state/receipts without writing endogenous DATABASE_PULSE semantic events or pulse:* semantic rows
layers.integration_boundary: raw StateLedger event cursor may not be replaced by effectivized projection deltas

layers.name: ABA_SAFE_PROJECTION_MAINTENANCE
layers.law: read-free event batches may reduce derived publication work only when final-state safety is explicit; equal final content never erases touched record/version/provenance identity; union all impacted seeds

layers.name: PHYSICAL_RANK_LIFECYCLE_AUDIT
layers.law: rank index BUILD/DROP stays outside cognition reads, uses physical+semantic CAS and same-transaction provenance-complete audit including actor, policy_provenance_ref, policy_decision_hash and monotonic audit sequence

layers.name: EVIDENCE_COALITION_COMPILER
layers.law: explicit CURRENT/OPEN/REFUTED/SUPERSEDED or support/blocker facets receive separate coalition slots; requested evidence classes do not compete destructively in one undifferentiated global rank; residual budget may use ordinary rank

layers.name: SUFFICIENCY_GATED_QUERY_AWARE_DEEPENING
layers.law: run typed sufficiency first; only explicit remaining gaps may trigger query/focus-conditioned ClayGraph/EAP deepening; explicit REFUTES/COUNTEREVIDENCE/CONTRADICTS edges are protected from relevance pruning; unsupported negation or zero corpus overlap falls back exactly to parent retrieval; conflict/revoked nodes remain negative space and cannot close the gap

layers.name: MODEL_INPUT_CAPSULE
layers.law: emit the smallest sufficient provenance-bound coalition with missing facets, alternatives and counterevidence; STOP when sufficient; ABSTAIN or route to a stronger conventional/dense/graph/tool retriever when insufficient; never pad merely to fill k

fusion_findings.finding: Semantic observer backaction and retrieval/projection optimization are distinct problems.
fusion_findings.consequence: PR143 and PR146 are complementary rather than substitutes: PR143 removes endogenous Pulse semantic self-churn; PR146 hardens rank lifecycle and query-aware derived retrieval.

fusion_findings.finding: Content equality is weaker than causal/version identity.
fusion_findings.consequence: S2 must remain downstream of raw event consumption and must conservatively invalidate every touched logical identity across A->B->A content-ABA chains.

fusion_findings.finding: Global Top-K is the wrong primary abstraction for queries requiring multiple epistemic facets.
fusion_findings.consequence: Compile required Evidence Coalition slots before global truncation; graph deepening should target unsatisfied typed gaps rather than simply expanding high-score neighborhoods.

fusion_findings.finding: Query-aware graph traversal can create confirmation bias if relevance damping erases explicit counterevidence.
fusion_findings.consequence: EAP-1.7.1-SAFE protects typed counter-relations at parent weight and falls back conservatively on unsupported negation/zero lexical overlap.

fusion_findings.finding: Accuracy gains from semantic preprocessing must not be misattributed to a storage engine comparison.
fusion_findings.consequence: Matched SQLite/PostgreSQL/pgvector/graph-native competitors must receive the same semantics; only execution-layer speed can then be compared as an engine effect.

new_counterhypotheses_and_obligations.counterhypothesis: Although PR143 removes semantic observer backaction, idle/catch-up Pulse execution receipts and checkpoints still share ledger.conn / the same SQLite file and may create writer-lock, WAL or checkpoint interference for authoritative StateLedger writers.
new_counterhypotheses_and_obligations.test: Matched same-file versus physically isolated execution-plane competition test on a WAL-reset-fixed SQLite family; record authoritative writer p50/p95/p99, SQLITE_BUSY/retry rate, WAL bytes, checkpoint latency and Pulse latency.

new_counterhypotheses_and_obligations.counterhypothesis: Downstream integration can bind the wrong execution semantics because PR143 body selects V6.1 while V6.4 source describes itself as preferred performance candidate.
new_counterhypotheses_and_obligations.test: Explicitly disposition V6.2/V6.3/V6.4 and pin one exact implementation ID before cross-branch matched integration.

new_counterhypotheses_and_obligations.counterhypothesis: Protecting a REFUTES edge from query damping could accidentally become an epistemic bypass if its target is CONFLICT/REVOKED.
new_counterhypotheses_and_obligations.test: Protected counter-relation must preserve only parent edge weight while parent negative-space still suppresses/blocks target and downstream propagation.
